title: The Well of the Undercroft
author: Mara Oyelaran
blurb: Sable Thornbury, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
